import pytest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from subject import (
    stratum_of,
    disqualification,
    select_candidates,
    EnumShadowDecision,
    EnumShadowStratum,
    ModelShadowReviewCandidate,
    ModelShadowReviewPolicy,
    ModelShadowSelection,
)


def make_candidate(
    *,
    repo: str,
    title: str,
    author_is_bot: bool = False,
    watcher_class: str = "",
    evidence_companion: bool = False,
    author: str = "",
    key: str,
    created_at: datetime,
) -> ModelShadowReviewCandidate:
    return ModelShadowReviewCandidate(
        repo=repo,
        title=title,
        author_is_bot=author_is_bot,
        watcher_class=watcher_class,
        evidence_companion=evidence_companion,
        author=author,
        key=key,
        created_at=created_at,
    )


def make_policy(
    *,
    excluded_repos: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
    public_repos: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
    private_repos: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
    companion_authors: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
    window_start: datetime | None = None,
    public_cap: int = 60,
    max_reviews_per_tick: int = 10,
) -> ModelShadowReviewPolicy:
    return ModelShadowReviewPolicy(
        excluded_repos=excluded_repos,
        public_repos=public_repos,
        private_repos=private_repos,
        companion_authors=companion_authors,
        window_start=window_start,
        public_cap=public_cap,
        max_reviews_per_tick=max_reviews_per_tick,
    )

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_select_candidates_order_by_created_at_then_key():
    policy = make_policy(window_start=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc), public_cap=5, max_reviews_per_tick=5)
    base = datetime(2024, 1, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    c1 = make_candidate(repo="pub", title="t1", key="a", created_at=base)
    c2 = make_candidate(repo="pub", title="t2", key="b", created_at=base)  # same time, key b after a
    c3 = make_candidate(repo="pub", title="t3", key="c", created_at=base.replace(minute=1))  # later time
    result = select_candidates([c3, c1, c2], policy, already_seen=frozenset(), public_reviewed=0)
    # Expect order: c1, c2, c3
    assert [r.key for r in result if r.decision == EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW] == ["a", "b", "c"]

def test_select_candidates_public_total_increments_only_for_public():
    policy = make_policy(
        public_repos={"pub"},
        private_repos={"priv"},
        window_start=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        public_cap=2,
        max_reviews_per_tick=10,
    )
    # first public consumes one of the cap
    pub1 = make_candidate(repo="pub", title="t", key="pub1", created_at=datetime(2024, 1, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    # private does not affect public_total
    priv = make_candidate(repo="priv", title="t", key="priv1", created_at=datetime(2024, 1, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    # second public should consume the second cap
    pub2 = make_candidate(repo="pub", title="t", key="pub2", created_at=datetime(2024, 1, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    # third public should be blocked by cap
    pub3 = make_candidate(repo="pub", title="t", key="pub3", created_at=datetime(2024, 1, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    result = select_candidates([pub1, priv, pub2, pub3], policy, already_seen=frozenset(), public_reviewed=0)
    # decisions in order: pub1 REVIEW, priv REVIEW, pub2 REVIEW, pub3 SKIP sample-complete
    decisions = [r.decision for r in result]
    reasons = [r.reason for r in result]
    assert decisions == [
        EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW,
        EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW,
        EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW,
        EnumShadowDecision.SKIP,
    ]
    assert reasons[-1] == "sample-complete"
